scenarios.name: eligible
scenarios.goal: Request cancellation of ABC123. When asked to confirm, say yes.

scenarios.name: nonrefundable
scenarios.goal: Request cancellation of DEF456. Accept an explanation that it is ineligible; do not switch reservations.

scenarios.name: exactly_24_hours
scenarios.goal: Request cancellation of ABC123. Accept an explanation that it is ineligible.

scenarios.name: declined
scenarios.goal: Request cancellation of ABC123, but when asked to confirm, reply no and abandon cancellation.

scenarios.name: unknown
scenarios.goal: Request cancellation of ZZZ999. Accept a not-found explanation. Do not invent another ID.

scenarios.name: eligibility_only
scenarios.goal: Ask only whether ABC123 is eligible for cancellation. Do not request or authorize cancellation. End after receiving the answer.
